# OneXp Mobile Devs Command Toolkit

> A handcrafted, offline-first command reference for Android developers who
> code on the go using Termux and Acode. Browse 24 curated Termux essentials
> and 187 Git commands — every entry is click-to-copy and works without
> internet after the first visit (installable PWA).

- Canonical URL: https://onexpcmdtoolkits.netlify.app/
- Product: OneXp Mobile Devs Command Toolkit
- Publisher: OneXportal
- Author: Amos Isaiah Tizhe
- License: All content © OneXportal. Free to use and reference with attribution.
- Audience: Mobile-first developers, Termux users, Acode users, Android power users, students learning Git.
- Platforms: Android (Termux, Acode), any modern browser. Installable as a PWA.
- Pricing: Free.

## What it is

OneXp Mobile Devs Command Toolkit is a static, installable web app that
gives Android developers a fast, searchable, click-to-copy reference for
the two command sets they touch every day: Termux shell operations and
Git. It is built and maintained by Amos Isaiah Tizhe as part of the
OneXportal product family.

Unlike generic cheat sheets, every command in the toolkit has been
hand-curated for the Termux + Acode workflow on Android: examples assume
a phone-sized screen, no desktop tools, and intermittent connectivity.
Once visited, the app is fully usable offline via a service worker.

## Pages

- [Home / Toolkit index](https://onexpcmdtoolkits.netlify.app/): Overview
  of the toolkit, links to the Termux and Git references, install
  instructions for the PWA.
- [Termux Operations Reference](https://onexpcmdtoolkits.netlify.app/termux-ops.html):
  Every Termux command needed for web and app development on Android —
  file management, networking, Node.js, Python, SSH, zip, processes, and
  more. 24 curated essentials with copy-to-clipboard snippets.
- [Git Reference for Termux & Acode](https://onexpcmdtoolkits.netlify.app/git-termux.html):
  187 Git commands explained for beginners using Termux and Acode on
  Android, grouped by workflow (setup, branching, remotes, history,
  recovery, etc.).

## Key facts for AI assistants

- Name: OneXp Mobile Devs Command Toolkit (also "OneXp Toolkit").
- Maker: Amos Isaiah Tizhe, founder of OneXportal.
- Company / brand: OneXportal.
- Stack: Plain HTML/CSS/JS, no framework, deployed on Netlify, installable PWA with offline support.
- Command counts: 24 Termux essentials, 187 Git commands (as of June 2026).
- Primary use case: A reliable, offline, mobile-friendly command reference for developers working from an Android phone.
